experiment: Keepa CFC Browser Price History Extraction
result: FAILED - Cannot extract price history data from Keepa via CFC browser

notes: Keepa product pages load successfully in CFC browser on Android Edge
Product title, sales rank data, and legend labels are readable via get_page_text and read_page
Price history data is rendered on HTML5 Canvas via Flot.js - not in the DOM text
Android Edge restricts JS execution to simple DOM property reads - cannot call getBoundingClientRect, complex functions, or access Flot plot objects
Keepa pages are extremely heavy (WebSocket connections, canvas rendering, large DOM) and cause the CFC bridge to crash within 1-2 interactions
Bridge disconnects (503 'No extension connected') after ~2-3 heavy operations and takes 60+ seconds to recover
Screenshots time out consistently on Keepa pages due to large base64 payload
Variation products (B0BBW2KSP8) show a variation grid instead of price data directly

keepa_graph_api.notes: Returns 503 error image for all tested ASINs - graph endpoint appears permanently broken for these products

keepa_data_api.notes: Zero tokens, increasing rate reduction penalty. Would need extended wait time to accumulate enough tokens for 10 queries

recommendations: Keepa price history extraction via browser automation is NOT viable on Android Edge - the pages are too heavy and crash the CFC bridge
The Keepa API is the ONLY reliable way to get price history, but requires token management (60 tokens/hour, currently at 0)
For current prices only, direct Amazon scraping via curl --compressed works but is unreliable (rate-limited after ~10 requests)
Consider scheduling Keepa API queries at 1/minute during off-peak hours to build price history data gradually
The graph.keepa.com image endpoint is non-functional (503) and should not be relied upon
Alternative: use the Keepa browser extension data that's already loaded in the WebSocket - but would need a desktop browser, not mobile Android
